findings.heading: Organization / プロジェクト内の整理
findings.proposition: The English suggests a "presentations" subfolder as one of the example project subfolders; the Japanese folder list (データ / スクリプト / 図や出力結果) omits it.
findings.reader_consequence: A Japanese reader setting up a project structure never sees the suggestion to keep a dedicated folder for presentations, so their recommended folder layout is narrower than the English one.

findings.heading: Settings / 初期設定
findings.proposition: The Japanese instructs the reader to set the "Restore .RData into workspace at startup" and "Save workspace to .RData on exit" controls to the value "No"; the English only says to set RStudio to not restore and not save, naming no control value.
findings.reader_consequence: A Japanese reader is told a specific UI value that the English never states. If the RStudio version in front of them offers checkboxes or a different option set rather than a Yes/No dropdown, the instruction does not match what they see.
